name: Side A
description: A Mac menu bar app that shows the 5-hour and weekly limits of all your Claude Code and Codex accounts and keeps the Mac-wide login on the account whose quota is most at risk of going unused.
requirements: An account with Claude Code or Codex access enabled
limitations: Relies on usage and login endpoints the CLIs use but do not document; CLI updates can change them
Codex accounts are tracked, not switched (experimental)
